name: Kong / 孔 令通
introduction: Hi, I’m Kong. I have around eight years of experience across Java/Spring, Vue/React, Linux, middleware, AWS migration and CI/CD in telecom, insurance and securities. I’ve independently delivered small web systems and APIs from requirements to release, using waterfall and agile approaches. My roles include PG, SE, sub-lead and PMO. I’ve earned PMP and AWS SAP, and I’m learning Amazon Bedrock, LangChain and LangGraph.

projects.title: kongPortfolio
projects.description: An evolving website built with React / TypeScript and Java 21 / Spring Boot. AWS infrastructure is managed with Terraform, with CI/CD, blue/green deployment and canary releases implemented.
projects.outcome: Live on AWS and under continued development. Verified Lambda releases from 10% canary traffic to full traffic, plus automatic rollback after a controlled stop. Amazon Bedrock Q&A integration is planned next; the endpoint currently returns a preparation status.
responsibilities: Built the frontend with React / TypeScript / Vite and the backend API with Java 21 / Spring Boot, including Japanese, Chinese and English language selection and a regular expression tool.
Provisioned AWS infrastructure with Terraform: private S3 + CloudFront for the frontend and API Gateway HTTP API + Lambda for the backend.
Connected source retrieval, tests, builds, staging verification and production releases with CodeConnections / CodePipeline / CodeBuild, retaining two manual production approval gates.
Implemented Lambda blue/green deployment with CodeDeploy, shifting 10% of traffic for five minutes before full rollout. Verified canary traffic shifts and automatic rollback after a controlled stop.
Implemented versioned frontend releases in S3, switching the CloudFront release pointer after verification.

projects.title: Call-center development and operational delivery

projects.outcome: Coordinated implementation approaches, priorities and schedules to resolve issues and prepare quarterly releases. Improved workflows with support tools and documented validation findings and technical issues for follow-on planning.
responsibilities: Quarterly releases and requirements coordination: Clarify customer requirements, confirm specifications and coordinate release scope. Assess business and system impacts and cross-system dependencies, supporting stakeholder agreement. Align approaches, priorities and schedules with customers and developers to resolve issues and prepare releases.

Technical investigation and development support: Investigate screens, batch processing and business logic to clarify change scope and impact. Discuss implementation approaches with developers based on customer requirements and existing system constraints. Provide Java implementation support and code-level fixes as needed.

Daily operations and workflow improvement: Investigate inquiries and defects through specification checks, logs, data and cause isolation. Coordinate cross-system work and ongoing issues with relevant departments. Review procedures and manual tasks, developing or adapting support tools to improve efficiency.

AWS environment checks and release support: Inspect AWS configuration including S3, EFS and RDS, document environment differences and verify release settings. Review release pipelines and deployment procedures and support automation. Use Athena to inspect logs and data for defect investigation and operational issue resolution.

Technical validation and PoC support: Research AI call-center technologies and AWS services and assess their applicability to requirements. Investigate automated testing and load-testing tools and support PoCs. Document findings and technical issues to support customer/developer decisions and follow-on initiatives.

projects.title: Business tool update following Salesforce changes

projects.outcome: Enabled continued use after the update and helped standardize installation through MSI packaging and Intune distribution.

Modify and reimplement existing Java functionality and remove dependencies on the old environment.
Implement communication encryption required by the system update.
Create a C# startup wrapper, package the application as MSI and support Intune automated installation.
Verify and test behavior, coordinate with users and address improvement requests.

projects.title: Telecom development, platform migration & team delivery
projects.description: Long-term work for the same telecom customer after graduating in 2018, spanning independently built web systems and APIs, large migrations, platform renewal and urgent investigation with limited documentation or unavailable source code. Worked as a developer, SE and sub-lead across implementation, customer coordination and team delivery.
projects.outcome: Independently delivered key APIs and small websites from initial requirements through production release. Supported cutovers through application changes and infrastructure configuration and verification; the team rolled out shared API access to more than 30 services. As sub-lead, supported a large migration spanning dozens of related projects through assigned-team progress and issue management, technical support and customer coordination.
responsibilities: Independent web and API delivery (Developer / SE): Build selected key APIs and small web systems from scratch, owning requirements, design, implementation, testing and production release. Develop web and batch functions, information lookup, extraction and CSV output, shared libraries and support tools. Coordinate specifications and additional requirements, execute unit/integration/performance tests, fix defects, tune performance and prepare releases and cutover checks.

Multi-system migration and platform renewal (SE): Assess migration impacts across multi-server systems, clarify required changes and adapt existing functions. Modify applications for Tomcat-to-WildFly migration; configure and verify WildFly, Nginx and Tomcat and test connected systems. Configure and verify Jenkins and help replace direct database access with shared APIs.

Urgent investigation with limited documentation or unavailable source: Compare available logs, configuration and observed behavior to investigate existing processing and impacts. Clarify technical uncertainties and response options with customers and stakeholders to support incident handling and changes.

Team management and large migration delivery (Sub-lead): Participate in a large system migration spanning dozens of related projects. Track assigned-team progress, issues and responses across teams of 1–15 people depending on the project, adjusting priorities and schedules. Assign work, provide technical support, review deliverables and coordinate customers and related teams to resolve issues and prepare releases.

Early development and database migration: From 2018, investigate, modify and test scheduled Shell tasks for Oracle-to-Hadoop migration and coordinate deliverables. Develop information lookup and upstream data transmission, contribute detailed designs and unit tests, and expand from implementation into design, platform work and team delivery.

note.title: Growing a trilingual blog, starting locally.
note.summary: Building kongPortfolio with React and Spring Boot. The first small increment and what comes next.
paragraphs: The first increment is a profile page in Japanese, Chinese and English. It uses browser preferences on the first visit and remembers a manually selected language.

React / TypeScript handles the interface; a Spring Boot API serves the content. There is no database initially: the backend reads public localized JSON. A Vite proxy connects the local frontend and API.
Working local increments come first. Article lists and detail pages precede the first AWS deployment, followed by CodePipeline / CodeBuild / ECR and then blue/green deployment.
